sentences.translation: There are three little pigs.
Their names are Max, Paula and Tim.
They live with mom in the warm house.
Mom says, “You're big now.
Find your own homes.
“ The pigs hug Mom and walk away.
Max is lazy.
He's building a house out of straw.
"That's quick! .
He sits down and eats an apple.
Paula builds a house out of wood.
She hammers a lot of nails.
Tim is diligent.
He builds from stone.
This takes a long time, but the house is strong.
A wolf comes into the forest.
He sees the straw house.
He blows twice.
The house falls.
Max runs to Paula.
The wolf comes to the wooden house.
He blows three times.
The wooden house also falls.
Max and Paula run to Tim.
The wolf comes to the stone house.
He blows and blows, but the house stays.
The wolf tries to get through the chimney.
Tim makes a warm fire in the oven.
The wolf quickly jumps away.
He's scared and runs into the woods.
Max and Paula learn a lot.
They say, “Diligence is important.
“ Tim invites them to dinner.
All three help mom with the cake.
Mom is happy.
The little pigs live close to Mom, but every pig now has a safe house.
In the evening, they sit at the large table.
Mom tells old stories.
Tim brings wood for the fire.
Max and Paula wash a lot of plates.
The wolf is not coming back.
In the forest, the animals hear only gentle wind.
The three little pigs sleep well and dream of warm beds.
